comment: Wrapper around {@link android.util.Log} which allows to set the log level.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL_ALL
variables.comment: Log level to log all messages.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL_INFO
variables.comment: Log level to only log informative, warning and error messages.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL_WARNING
variables.comment: Log level to only log warning and error messages.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL_ERROR
variables.comment: Log level to only log error messages.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL_OFF
variables.comment: Log level to disable all logging.

methods.name: public static int getLogLevel()
methods.comment: Returns current {@link LogLevel} for ExoPlayer logcat logging.

methods.name: public static void setLogLevel(@LogLevel int logLevel)
methods.comment:
* Sets the {@link LogLevel} for ExoPlayer logcat logging.
   *
   * @param logLevel The new {@link LogLevel}.

methods.name: public static void setLogStackTraces(boolean logStackTraces)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether stack traces of {@link Throwable}s will be logged to logcat. Stack trace logging
   * is enabled by default.
   *
   * @param logStackTraces Whether stack traces will be logged.

* Returns a string representation of a {@link Throwable} suitable for logging, taking into * account whether {@link #setLogStackTraces(boolean)} stack trace logging} is enabled. * *

Stack trace logging may be unconditionally suppressed for some expected failure modes (e.g., * {@link Throwable Throwables} that are expected if the device doesn't have network connectivity) * to avoid log spam. * * @param throwable The {@link Throwable}. * @return The string representation of the {@link Throwable}.
